issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְזִ֥יז שָׂ֝דַ֗י' refers to 'the creeping/teeming things of the field' (or 'the moving things of the field'), not 'mọi loài vật chạy nhảy trong đồng cỏ' (all animals running/leaping in the meadow). The Vietnamese adds 'chạy nhảy' (running/leaping) which is not in the Hebrew, and 'đồng cỏ' (meadow) is a specific rendering of 'field' that may be acceptable, but the main issue is the added descriptor 'chạy nhảy' which is not present in the Hebrew.
